prerequisites: English language skills equivalent to 12th grade level.

learning_outcomes.text: Professional, English-language discourse and action competence considering (inter-)cultural elements.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to technical language in fundamental areas of electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and environmental and building technology
Practice and application of presentation techniques
teaching_methods: Guided self-study (possibly in the multi-media language lab)
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the written exam must be passed. The weighting of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
bibliography: Eric H. Glenndinning, Oxford English for Electrical and Mechanical Engineering
P. Donovan, Basic English for Science
